desc: The new standard of personal defense. Super Carry Pro .45 ACP pistols are made in the Kimber Custom Shop to unequaled requirements of usability, dependability and performance. Light, powerful and loaded with the very best features for concealed carry, this is the pistol to have on your side. The Super Carry family was designed with a single purpose, to be the finest concealed carry pistols available today. Night sights, ambidextrous thumb safety and match grade trigger group are standard. Stainless steel slides and lightweight aluminum frames wear KimPro II, a proprietary high-tech finish that is self-lubricating and extremely durable. Super Carry Pro pistols combine dynamic style with outstanding quality and performance—just what you expect from Kimber.
